title: Three Autumns and One Short Cart
subtitle: 四季节令 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 四季节令（人与自然·自然生态·四季与节令）
meta: 主题语境：四季节令（人与自然·自然生态·四季与节令）　|　核心词汇：harvest　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 harvest 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the farmer ① brought in the harvest that no neighbour in the valley would have described, and he said the bringing was the whole of the autumn. The ② harvest, meaning the crop itself and not the cart, ran three autumns and stayed undescribed in the book; a harvest, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ harvest in that valley had the same short cart beside it, and the ④ harvest at the far field, meaning the yield they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A harvest, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the farmer said the describing is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the harvest was the whole of the matter, meaning the reward and not the crop. The ⑥ harvest, meaning the reward and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; harvest, he said, is either something you bring in or the only word that means both a crop and a reward. He said the reward is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ harvest had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short cart. The ⑧ harvest of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in November, was one valley and three autumns of describing; harvest, he said, is either the yield at the far field or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ harvest I remember is the crop described in the ledger, which closed in 1971 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ harvest, my mother said in 1973, is the only crop that improves by being described; every harvest, she said, is a reward that has agreed to look like a crop. She said the reward was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 收获；收成（指山谷里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 收成；收获（指那些庄稼本身，与板车相对）
C. 固定搭配：bring in the harvest 收割庄稼
D. n. 收成（指留给孩子们学着收的那一茬）
E. n. 收获（抽象总称，指一处山谷的收成之事）
F. n. 收成（指账簿里写到、被称过的那一茬）
G. n. 成果；回报（指一件事里人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 收效（抽象总称，指人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: brought in the harvest that no neighbour in the valley would have described
The harvest, meaning the crop itself and not the cart
the harvest at the far field
the harvest was the whole of the matter
the harvest had become a line in a ledger
The harvest of the whole thing
A harvest, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: bring in the harvest 意为“收割庄稼”，1964 年那位农夫收割了山谷里没有一位邻居肯描述的一茬庄稼。
harvest 意为“收成、收获”，指那些庄稼本身而不是板车，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被描述。
harvest 意为“收成、收获”，指山谷里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一辆矮矮的板车。
harvest 意为“收成”，指最远那片田里留给孩子们学着收的那一茬，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
harvest 意为“成果、回报”，指一件事里人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份回报就是那件事的全部。
harvest 意为“收效”，指人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西而不是那茬庄稼，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
harvest 意为“收成”，指账簿里写到、被称过的那一茬，到 1969 年这一茬成了账簿里的一行。
harvest 意为“收获”，农夫十一月写道，整件事的收成之事是一处山谷和三个秋天的描述。
harvest 意为“收成”，我记得的是账簿里描述过的那一茬，1971 年归仓了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一茬。
harvest 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，收成是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的庄稼。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年那位农夫收割了山谷里没有一位邻居肯描述的一茬庄稼，他说收割才是那个秋天的全部。（bring in the harvest）
那茬收成，指的是那些庄稼本身而不是板车，经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被描述。（harvest）
那处山谷里每一次收成旁边都有同一辆矮矮的板车。（harvest）
最远那片田里那一茬收成，指的是他们留给孩子们学着收的那一茬，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（harvest）
叔叔说这份回报就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那茬庄稼。（harvest）
1973 年母亲说，收成是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的庄稼。（harvest）
answers: In 1964 the farmer brought in the harvest that no neighbour in the valley would have described, and he said the bringing was the whole of the autumn.
The harvest, meaning the crop itself and not the cart, ran three autumns and stayed undescribed in the book.
Every harvest in that valley had the same short cart beside it.
The harvest at the far field, meaning the yield they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the harvest was the whole of the matter, meaning the reward and not the crop.
A harvest, my mother said in 1973, is the only crop that improves by being described.
